newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end off 0.55 pct on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end off 0.55 pct on profit-taking.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange edged down Thursday on profit-taking, but was expected to recover in the week's final session, brokers said.
"It was a day of technical corrections, profit-taking," said Luis Cueva of Argos brokerage. "For Friday, we expect a stable or slightly positive market."
The General Index fell 0.55 percent to 1,615.98 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index slipped 0.45 percent to 2,304.62.
In a total of 1,961 trades, volume was estimated at 49.4 million soles ($18.7 million) as 33 stocks fell, 31 were stable and 31 gained.
"It was time for a fall on the Lima market," added Cueva. "Yesterday, nearly all the bolsas in the region, apart from ours, dropped under the influence of a correction in New York."
Among leaders, benchmark Telefonica del Peru lost 0.17 percent to 5.88 soles on 1.5 million shares or 18.39 percent of total volume.
Electricity company Edegel lost 3.82 percent to 1.26 percent, while Cementos Lima slipped 1.52 percent to 4.55 soles.
